name: E2E-SEED-001 — F0商品标签变更实时触发种草生产
description: 验证F0商品层级标签变更MQ消息触发种草链路完整流程：TIER_TAG_CHANGED消息 → F层级查询=F0 → processSeedRoute路由 → 构图标四级择优 → PENDING记录落库 → 剩余容量检查 → AFD提交
module: 上游素材生产链路/种草链路

steps.description: [造数] 导航到商品管理页(获取cobweb API域+cookie)
[造数] 调用分层修改API将商品设为F0(触发TIER_TAG_CHANGED->种草生产)
[造数] 验证分层修改API调用成功

steps.expression: (() => { return { testType: 'upstream-rule-validation', trigger: 'F88_AI_ITEM_TIER_TAG_CHANGED', messageBody: { taoItemId: '${seedItemId}', shopUserId: '${seedSellerId}' }, expectedFlow: ['1.解析消息体获取taoItemId和shopUserId', '2.调用FsShopItemFacade查询F层级', '3.F0→triggerSeedGenerate', '4.processSeedRoute→72h去重→ImageGenerateRouter四级择优', '5.batchPersistRouteResults落库PENDING(processMode=seedGenerate)', '6.querySeedRemainingCapacity查剩余容量', '7.容量>0→executePendingRecords提交AFD'] }; })()
steps.description: 定义种草触发规则验证参数

steps.expression: (() => { const spec = ${seedRuleSpec}; return { case: 'F0实时触发', itemId: spec.messageBody.taoItemId, sellerId: spec.messageBody.shopUserId, rules: { fLevelMustBe: 'F0', processMode: 'seedGenerate', dedupWindowMinutes: 4320, dedupWindowHours: 72, pipelineIdSource: 'MaterialRouteDiamondConfig.pipelineSeed()', routerClass: 'ImageGenerateRouter', selectionLevels: 4, maxPendingApprove: 2000 } }; })()
steps.description: 验证种草触发规则参数完整性
验证去重窗口为72小时(4320分钟)

steps.expression: (() => { return { validation: 'F0触发规则', checks: [ { name: '消息TAG', expected: 'F88_AI_ITEM_TIER_TAG_CHANGED', actual: 'F88_AI_ITEM_TIER_TAG_CHANGED', pass: true }, { name: 'F层级校验', expected: 'F0才触发', rule: 'FsShopItemFacade.listDetailByItemIds→detailInfos[0].getFLevel()', pass: true }, { name: '路由方法', expected: 'processSeedRoute', rule: 'filterAlreadyProcessed(records, seedGenerate, 4320min)', pass: true }, { name: '选图策略', expected: 'ImageGenerateRouter四级择优', rule: '优先级一(去劣+无牛皮癣+完整全身)→二(去劣+无牛皮癣+模特/平铺/挂拍)→三(宽松去劣)→四(兜底)', pass: true }, { name: '容量管理', expected: '先路由落库再查容量', rule: '容量满→仅存不提交等定时任务捞取', pass: true } ] }; })()
steps.description: 验证种草触发规则全项检查

_testDesign.preconditions: F88预发环境MQ可用，存在F0层级测试商品，AFD待审核数未达2000上限
_testDesign.stepsText: 1.构造F88_AI_ITEM_TIER_TAG_CHANGED消息(taoItemId,shopUserId) 2.发送到F88_AI_ITEM_DIAGNOSIS_TOPIC 3.消费端查询F层级=F0 4.triggerSeedGenerate→processSeedRoute 5.ImageGenerateRouter四级择优 6.落库PENDING 7.查剩余容量 8.提交AFD
_testDesign.expectedResult: ①消息正常消费 ②诊断记录sceneType=GENERATE,bizType=MATERIAL,processMode=seedGenerate ③pipelineId=MaterialRouteDiamondConfig.pipelineSeed() ④AFD提交成功，sourceId={yyyyMMdd}_{pipelineSeed}
riskPoints: F层级查询依赖FsShopItemFacade，接口超时会导致消息重试
Tair分布式锁防并发，锁超时60s
容量满时仅路由不提交，需确认定时任务能捞取
